message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard chart titled “Smartphone Market Share in Europe” (O1) prints the current Europe smartphone market-share values on its slices: Apple (45%) (O2), Xiaomi (30%) (O3), Samsung (15%) (O4), and Others (10%) (O5). Comparing these values, Apple’s 45% is the highest (45% > 30% > 15% > 10%). The supplied rule states the premium retail promotion budget is reserved for the current market-share leader, so the leader is Apple.", "option_label": "Select Apple for the premium EU retail promotion budget"}
